notes.title: Small steam update
notes.content:
Hello Planimal trainers, as our promise to keep you all updated, we've just launched a small update with various fixes. In addition to this, the demo on our steam page has been updated to reflect the fixes from QOL 1 & 2.

Switch has also been brought up to parity, with the PC version which you can read about here.

notes.title: QOL2 launch date + features expanded
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

With QOL2 coming to PC this Thursday the 15th, its filled with some new additions and bug fixes that you can check out in our last post. 

Below are some of the new features being shipped with the update:

Introducing Aster & The Clothing Store
A new merchant arrives in town.
- Change your character to 1 of 32 appearances
- Aster can be romanced and gifted, the conclusion resulting in a reward cutscene
- Shop visuals also improved

Combat 2.0
New options to turn the tide in your favour
- Escape Battle option now available
- Swap Planimals mid-battle
- Heal Planimals between battles with potions bought from the clinic

House Customization
Time for a facelift
- 5 different house styles available to purchase from the sign outside the player house
- Cosmetic changes persist across house levels. 

Festival Improvements
My fish is bigger than yours!
- Livestock festival will trigger a cutscene after 90 seconds of being at the festival
- Fishing contest allows the player to submit a fish for judging
- The cookoff allows players to enter a dish of their choice to be scrutinized

notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

First off, as we have said numerous times now, thank you for the feedback that’s been shared since the beta through to launch and beyond, it shapes the way we develop and build the game.

After the post-launch flurry of updates, things have been a little quieter, which isn’t ideal. We really want to provide you with meaningful updates which we couldn't do until the initial bug fixing patches were completed and work progressed on the more quality of life focused update which was promised.

We’re a small team but we’re passionate about what we do and giving you an enjoyable gaming experience is really what we sign up for by coming to work in the games industry. We know there have been frustrations out there and despite things being quieter on the communication front, we’ve certainly tried to give every player a voice, hear your concerns and take them to heart. We don’t want to overpromise on something until we’re sure of it, so a lot of Monster Harvest has been behind the scenes work lately.

With that said, we’re in a position now to share details on the next updates for Monster Harvest! These will come in the form of 2 updates, for all platforms.

Update 1
Coming early in the new year! It will land on PC first, followed by consoles which require some additional porting and certification before we can get them out to you.

Massive UI overhaul

 Menus all optimized and some redesigned
  Text popups for pickups and items
  Rescaled multiple text instance

- Controller support improvements

 Improving controls & menu navigation when using a controller

- Crop signposting

 Crops will now more clearly tell you when they are ready to harvest

- A map of Planimal Point is now available

- See where you stand with the resident of Planimal Point with a new relationship tracker

- Clearer stamina and exp usage and caps

- General game & economy balancing 

- Lots of minor bug fixes 

Then there will be another update a little further along the new year which will bring big changes to the Planimal System, customisation & in-game story!
We’ll share more details on that soon, but we wanted to give you an overview of what is being worked on.

Thank you for playing Monster Harvest and stay tuned for more in the new year, happy holidays from us all at Merge Games & Maple Powered Games!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1363350/Monster_Harvest/

notes.title: 大家好
notes.content:
大家好！

我们仍在调查农作物不生长的问题，一些玩家在4号补丁更新后的反馈非常有帮助。大家提供的游戏数据对解决这个问题非常有价值，所以如果大家将于踊跃把数据发给我们，就可以更快找到问题所在。

以下是分享你的游戏数据的步骤。

 打开任何windows explorer窗口，将以下内容粘贴到搜索栏中

notes.title: Monster Harvest Launch... and beyond
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633059/694694ca338cea97e9d8012f9b6e78a33b217e2a.png
Hey everyone,

Today is the day many have been waiting for, Planimal Point is open!

It's been quite a ride getting here. Monster Harvest began, honestly, as quite a small project. The core concept of the game has always been a unique twist on the genre, but the more we showed the game to people, the more expectations grew and we adjusted the scope of the project to align better with those rising expectations. 

Hence Monster Harvest was delayed a number of times whilst we worked on expanding the scope of the game and working in features requested by the growing community, feedback from early beta testing and realising further ambitions for just what Monster Harvest could be. Building upon a concept is a road lined with pitfalls, and this is why we took the increasingly harder decision to delay rather than try to rush out with features packed in without doing the necessary testing.

A lot of testing took place, but there's no testing that comes near the efficacy of opening up the game to the public. We're seeing from early reviewers that a number of bugs still made their way into the final product, and we wanted to let you know this and to assure you that we're working hard to squash these bugs. We have a bug reporting thread pinned in the Steam forums and welcome anyone to join the Merge Games discord and use our bug reporting bot there.

We also want to tell you that the launch for Monster Harvest is really only the beginning. Ongoing bug fixes will happen, but the support for Monster Harvest will go further than that. The strength of the community around Monster Harvest has been truly wonderful and is very humbling. We love Monster Harvest just as much as you, and we have lots of exciting plans in-store, so watch this space and start making plans to settle down in Planimal Point! This is version 1.0, there’s lots more to come and we’re very excited about the future of Monster Harvest!

So with all that said, what can you look forward to next in Planimal Point?

Our first update is our Festivals Update

The festival update aims to expand the existing festivals in the game with minigames, new character interactions, and rewards.

The festival update aims to expand the existing festivals in the Monster Harvest with minigames, new character interactions, and rewards. We’ll be expanding all festivals across Planimal Point and dynamically update the world to match the festivities. We'll also be including festival specific decorations and more...


 New minigames
 New character interactions
 New rewards.

We'll also be including festival specific decorations and more…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633059/cdb7cc19b7362afa251d7dd554a33b866141915f.png

Homemaker Update
A new shop is opening up in Planimal Point! But what does that entail...? 

And more to come… Stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633059/3a60692a7d0ad05a6ee5da81509269a78974d427.png

MOST FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS:

What is planned for the future of Monster Harvest?
We have detailed this in a Steam community post! Long story short there is A lot planned, you can find the full details here.

Will Monster Harvest have multiplayer?
We think Monster Harvest is best experienced as a single-player experience. We do take all your feedback on board though and consider many community requests for future updates!

Is there an invite link for this server where I can ask other questions not answered here?
https://discord.gg/mergegames

What platforms is Monster Harvest available on?
Monster Harvest is currently available  on PC, Switch, PS4 & XB1

Is there Romance in the game?
Not currently

Will there be mod/workshop support?
There are currently no plans for this

Does the game have cloud-saving on Steam?
Unfortunately not at the moment

Will there be controller support?
Yes, the game has full controller support.

How is Monster Harvest different from other games in the genre?
There are some fantastic games in the genre and there are of course similarities between Monster Harvest and other pixel art farming games! The developers enjoy a range of titles in the genre and are incredibly excited to bring their own contribution to fans. What makes Monster Harvest truly unique, is that it adds the excitement of a monster battle game with RPG elements to add some action to the peace and quiet.

We definitely do some things differently and hope that fans of the genre might find something a little different to enjoy in Planimal Point!

What languages will Monster Harvest be available in?
The game will be available in:
English
French
German
Spanish
Brazilian Portuguese
Russian
Japanese
Simplified Chinese 
Korean

I’m a content creator/influencer - who can I speak to about access to Monster Harvest?
Reach out to us at marketing@mergegames.com - we’re humbled by the volume of requests we get for Monster Harvest so please bear with us if there is a delay in responding to you.

Thanks so much for reading and for coming on the Monster Harvest journey with us!

Store Page.

Join the Discord.

notes.title: Demo - Update 1
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've loved seeing so many people roll up their sleeves and get to farming in the Monster Harvest demo.

There's been some wonderful feedback and we wanted to thank everyone for letting us know how they've been getting on in Planimal Point.

There's a lot of small bug fixes behind the scenes but here are some key fixes

 "Out of bounds" errors fixed throughout the game.
 Issues with disappearing tools in chests should be fixed
 Issues where crops decide to walk off in the night should be solved - it seems the professor might have been spreading slime where he shouldn't!
 Some character sprites and portraits adjusted to more accurately reflect the intended design
 Various balance changes to more accurately reflect the intended full game experience.

All of your feedback is very helpful and very welcome so please do continue to share and we look forward to opening up the full game for you very soon!

notes.title: Monster Harvest has moved to July 8th
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We have some good news and some bad news to share today!

First, the bad news. The train to Planimal Point is slightly delayed and we have moved Monster Harvest back to July 8th.

We ran a closed beta and had some wonderful feedback from our testers, but we made the decision that we wanted to increase the amount of content in the game for release based on that feedback. 

So whilst we’re very sorry to delay your trip to Planimal Point, the good news is that we’re extremely excited to bring you a game with some fantastic additions on release! 

There’s a bunch of new things to look forward to including;


 Dungeon Minimap

 Variant dungeon rooms with some rare and unique encounters

 Unlockable Planimal attacks

 More crop variations

 New additions to the town and an overhaul of NPC’s and relationships

 Farm size expanded

 More structured goals and rewards for completing certain milestones in game

 New female character model


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633059/58b88687f8780541a6f8baf540b553e8d4d49622.png

We're really looking forward to delivering an even bigger game and hope you join us in Planimal Point on July 8th!

notes.title: Monster Harvest is coming 13th May!
notes.content:

Features

 Farm with mutants! Use magical slimes to mutate the crops you grow on your farm.
 Collectible Planimal companions! Some slimes mutate your crops into Planimals! 
 Take your loyal companions into battle as you look to save Planimal Point from the Evil SlimeCo.  
 Three unique seasons: Dry, Wet, and Dark - Strange weather and seasons shift what the player can grow.
 Venture into the town of Planimal Point - Discover the people and creatures that live there, build relationships to gain discounts in stores.
 Craft dozens of items for your farm and your house.


We can't wait to see you experiment with a range of Planimals and customise your very own piece of Planimal Point!
